summary: Plan ASM readiness, licensing pathways, and responsible-sourcing records. Explore this five-day advanced course and its practical outputs.
lede: Artisanal and small-scale mining formalisation helps professionals assess operations and plan feasible routes toward legal recognition. It is for mining officers, ASM programme leads, responsible-sourcing specialists and development practitioners turning policy goals into workable steps. Learners practise readiness assessments, formalisation pathway design, and planning mineral due-diligence and traceability records.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is for professionals who already work with mining operations, mineral supply chains, or development programmes and need to plan or assess ASM formalisation activities.
outcomes: ASM Health And Safety Checklist Development
modules: OECD Due Diligence and Mineral Records
prerequisites: Prior professional experience in artisanal or small-scale mining, mining administration, mineral supply chains, or development programming is expected. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel installed for the monitoring-dashboard exercise.
